Anna (CS): just got off call w/ BlueHarbor onboarding team — quick recap and asks
Anna (CS): main pain: onboarding search relevance and slow embedding updates, customer quote: "search returns stale Q1 data, our reps choke"
Anna (CS): asked for 2 things: (1) feature request to surface fresh embeddings on deploy, (2) a short enablement playbook for reps
Devon (PM): thanks anna — do we have repro steps or a sample prompt/trace?
Anna (CS): they recorded a short clip, will upload. repro: customer calls embeddings refresh once/day but our per-route cache TTL is 24h so race with their update window
Mike (Product): sounds like cache TTL + refresh-on-deploy would help. low-effort: expose per-route TTL override in console (config param). med-effort: add a deploy-triggered refresh API
Devon (PM): can you add the exact customer timing? we should decide scope for next sprint.
Anna (CS): customer updates catalog @ 02:30 UTC daily, reports the worst UX between 03:00-06:00 UTC
Mike (Product): marking as P1 for onboard experience. estimated: TTL UI + API hook = 2 sprints for small team, or quick patch: add `override_ttl` flag for dedicated customers
Sana (Enablement): I can draft a 1-pager for reps describing workaround and wording: "if search looks stale, hit Refresh in Console and note dataset version". also can run a 15-min training for BlueHarbor next Wed
Devon (PM): assign owners & tags. Anna, can you create a ticket in product board and add the customer context? tag as `cs:blueharbor:onboard-ux` and `prio:renewal-risk`
Anna (CS): will create ticket now and paste link. putting proposed acceptance criteria: 1) console TTL override exposed per-route, 2) deploy API triggers KV cache refresh, 3) docs + rep playbook published
FeedbackBot: New feedback entry created: customer=BlueHarbor, type=onboarding, severity=high, id=FB-2026-322
Mike (Product): thumbs up. if renewal risk label accurate?
Devon (PM): yes — renewal conversation in 5 weeks; small fix now reduces churn risk.
Sana (Enablement): once ticket is triaged, I'll prepare a short script + slack template for reps to use during outreach
Anna (CS): uploaded call snippet: https://files.redwood/blueharbor-call-2026-03-21.mp3
Devon (PM): created board card: https://app.prodboard/issue/RED-2481 — assigned to @mike, target milestone: sprint-12
Mike (Product): picking this up. will prototype TTL override UI and add API hook.
Anna (CS): thanks team — next steps: 1) Mike prototype, 2) Devon confirm priority in sprint planning, 3) Sana prepare playbook, 4) Anna to follow up w/ BlueHarbor and share interim workaround
Sana (Enablement): noted, will have playbook draft by Tue EOD
Anna (CS): tagging @Devon (PM) for visibility to renewal team :thumbsup:
